# What is LawSynth?

LawSynth is a scientific model studio. It ingests multivariate time series and
produces a **World IR** — one typed, executable representation that combines
equations, causal hypotheses, regimes, uncertainty, and interventions.

## Why a World IR?

The individual ingredients already have strong open-source implementations. The
missing product layer is a single representation every stage can exchange.

- Rust owns correctness-sensitive execution.
- Algorithms exchange World IR, not private object graphs.
- Every run produces an inspectable, reproducible `.lsworld` bundle.

> Model systems, not screenshots.

# Quickstart

Install the CLI and run discovery against a sample dataset.

```bash
$ cargo install lawsynth-cli
$ lawsynth discover lynx-hare.csv --out predator-prey.lsworld
```

Open the resulting bundle in the Studio to inspect candidate laws.
